product_contract: Before any Build/Buy mutation that changes a room or building structure, the host must have an attested Sims My Library save of that building. The library item is the operator's human-judgment revert point. Game Save As (BI_TMP_/BI_CONT_) remains a separate recovery path and does not satisfy this gate. Applies to every host/agent caller — not an optional courtesy.
motivating_corrections: 2026-11-08 operator: agent deleted house walls without first saving the building to the library so the change could be reverted; human judgment must be preserved by host logic before room mutation.

rejected.why: Game Save As recovers the whole session; it is not the Build Mode building/room library revert the operator required, and prior thrash still skipped both.
Chat reminders do not bind host_stack or admit_mutation; another agent can still sledge walls.
Saving wreckage after deleting walls does not preserve the pre-mutation judgment.
Room/structure tools and wall/floor targets are never optional; soft exceptions invite the same failure.

library_vs_save_as.library_checkpoint: Build Mode Save to My Library for the building/room blueprint — revert by placing from Library
library_vs_save_as.game_save_as: Session Save As under BI_TMP_/BI_CONT_ — still required for some destructive leases, never a substitute for library checkpoint

freshness_rule: library_checkpoint.model_revision MUST equal the current lot model revision at admit time; any later observe without a new library save invalidates the gate

success: if room mutation planned and no fresh library_checkpoint -> plan/admit SAVE_TO_LIBRARY only
then spatial + integrity + optional Save As gates
observe outcome into same model (invalidates prior library checkpoint until re-saved)

violations.BUILDING_SCOPE_MISMATCH: Attestation building_id does not match mutation building_id
violations.LIBRARY_CAPTURE_MISSING: Attestation without capture_ref proving the library save UI outcome
